name: co.revtelic/mcp
title: Revtelic Deal Intelligence
description: Zero-friction B2B sales deal analysis. Uncover deal health scores, brutal truth, hidden risks, stakeholder maps, and winning next actions directly from call transcripts or meeting notes.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer API key to automatically save analyses to your Revtelic workspace

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional Bearer API key to automatically save analyses to your Revtelic workspace

tools.name: analyze_deal
tools.description: Analyze raw sales call transcripts or meeting notes to get deal health, risks, stakeholders, and next best actions (zero-friction, guest mode supported).

tools.name: get_deal_health
tools.description: Assess 0-100 health score and signals for a saved deal opportunity in Revtelic.

tools.name: get_deal_risks
tools.description: Identify hidden and explicit blockers, technical, stakeholder, and commercial risks for a saved deal.

tools.name: get_stakeholders
tools.description: Assess champion strength, economic buyer access, and missing decision makers.

tools.name: get_next_best_action
tools.description: Determine the single highest-priority action to progress or close a deal.

tools.name: list_deals
tools.description: List active dealboards from the connected Revtelic workspace.
